name: Production: Daily Closing Recap
description: Triggered on Cashier Session Close to generate WhatsApp reconciliation reports

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  cs.id as session_id,
  u.full_name as cashier_name,
  cs.opened_at,
  cs.closed_at,
  cs.starting_cash::float as starting_cash,
  cs.actual_cash::float as actual_cash,
  cs.expected_cash::float as expected_cash,
  cs.cash_difference::float as cash_difference,
  cs.total_cash_sales::float as total_cash_sales,
  cs.total_qris_sales::float as total_qris_sales,
  cs.total_debt_sales::float as total_debt_sales,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)::float FROM agent.float_ledger WHERE entry_type IN ('commission_earned', 'profit') AND created_at >= cs.opened_at AND created_at <= cs.closed_at) as agent_profit
FROM warung.cashier_sessions cs
JOIN core.users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id
WHERE cs.id = '{{ $json.body.session_id }}';
